tactics.label: fake_social_proof
tactics.reason: A pile of keywords in the title is there for search, not for you. It promises a lot and shows clips with no context.

reality_check: These are real people getting hurt, cut into a highlight reel. The channel earns from every view, so it needs you to feel the fight is entertainment. If it got to you, that is the edit working, not something wrong with you.

concern.reason: These clips turn real injuries into entertainment and hide what happened after. While watching, notice how the edit skips the part where someone does not get up.
